title: 6 Muscle Trucks Nobody Remembers (One Beat a Corvette)
description:
In nineteen seventy-eight, a red Dodge pickup with wooden trim and chrome exhaust stacks beat a Chevrolet Corvette to one hundred miles per hour. In nineteen ninety-one, a small GMC truck could reach sixty in about four point three seconds. In twenty twenty-six, Ram brought back a pickup with seven hundred seventy-seven horsepower. Muscle trucks have a long, wild history, and most people have forgotten the best part of it.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
